mapper.select: SELECT f.* FROM flashcard f JOIN deck d ON f.deck_id = d.id WHERE f.next_review_at <= NOW() AND (#{userId} IS NULL OR d.user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN f.stability IS NULL OR f.last_reviewed_at IS NULL THEN 999999 ELSE (TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, f.last_reviewed_at, NOW()) / 1440.0) / f.stability END DESC, f.next_review_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
